summary: Iteration 94: IP Whitelisting per Tenant + Upload Speed Optimizations. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend verified: IP Whitelist modal in Tenant Management works correctly with enable checkbox, IP input, Add/Remove buttons, and Save functionality.

TEST_01_get_ip_whitelist_returns_config.notes: GET /api/admin/platform/tenants/{tenant_id}/ip-whitelist returns whitelist config with enabled and ips fields

TEST_02_put_ip_whitelist_sets_ips_and_en.notes: PUT sets IPs and enabled flag correctly

TEST_05_put_ip_whitelist_accepts_mixed_i.notes: Accepts mix of single IPs and CIDR ranges

TEST_06_verify_whitelist_persisted.notes: GET after PUT confirms data persisted in database

TEST_07_cleanup_whitelist.notes: Whitelist disabled and cleared after tests

TEST_12_bulk_delete_uses_in_operator.notes: $in operator used for bulk daily_sales delete (line 698)

TEST_13_no_per_day_loop_for_delete.notes: Days collected into set first, then single bulk delete

STEP_01_tenant_management_loads.notes: Platform Admin page loads with tenant table

STEP_02_lock_icon_visible.notes: Lock icon button visible in Actions column for production tenant

STEP_03_modal_opens.notes: IP Whitelist modal opens with title 'IP Whitelist — production'

STEP_04_enable_checkbox.notes: Enable IP whitelisting checkbox present and functional

STEP_05_ip_input_field.notes: IP input field with placeholder 'IP or CIDR (e.g. 203.0.113.0/24)'

STEP_07_save_button.notes: Save button with data-testid='save-ip-whitelist' calls PUT endpoint

STEP_08_cancel_button.notes: Cancel button closes modal without saving

critical_code_review_comments: IP Whitelist endpoints properly implemented in /app/backend/routes/super_admin.py (lines 1045-1088)
IP validation uses Python ipaddress module supporting both single IPs and CIDR ranges
Middleware at server.py line 2806 enforces whitelist with super_admin bypass
Upload pipeline optimizations verified: BATCH=5000, asyncio.gather for parallel fetches, $in for bulk deletes
Frontend TenantManagement.jsx has proper data-testid attributes for testing
Modal correctly shows tenant name and has all required UI elements
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Tests used existing production tenant.
